### 版本能力汇总 / Release highlights

- 重组 APK 加固页面：输出文件名、保存目录与低频设置分区展示，并持久化常用加固方案 / Reorganized the protection page with dedicated output controls, grouped low-frequency settings, and persisted protection defaults
- 增加加固前风险检查：识别签名、已加固载荷、DEX、ABI、`minSdkVersion`、`extractNativeLibs`、split APK 与 Android 共享库兼容信号 / Added preflight checks for signatures, existing payloads, DEX, ABIs, `minSdkVersion`, `extractNativeLibs`, split APKs, and Android shared-library compatibility signals
- 直接只读解析 APK 二进制 Manifest，不依赖 apktool 或资源展开；单独选择 split APK 会明确阻止 / Added direct read-only binary Manifest parsing without apktool or resource extraction; standalone split APKs are explicitly blocked
- 增加可复制的脱敏加固诊断摘要，不包含路径、证书、密码、包名、业务类名或原始错误文本 / Added copyable sanitized protection diagnostics that exclude paths, certificates, passwords, package names, business class names, and raw error text
- 根据 APK 最低 SDK 提示标准模式与 Android 4.4 工控兼容模式的适用范围，不自动改变用户选择 / Added `minSdkVersion`-based guidance for standard and Android 4.4 industrial compatibility modes without changing the user's selection automatically
- 匿名桌面工具统计按工具版本和固定任务阶段聚合，保持可关闭且不采集 APK、路径、包名、证书或密码 / Added opt-out anonymous desktop-tool metrics aggregated only by tool version and fixed task stage, without collecting APKs, paths, package names, certificates, or passwords
- 兼容内容实际为 JPEG、扩展名却为 `.png` 的普通资源；仅无损改名为 `.jpg`，九宫格资源和命名冲突保持失败关闭 / Added compatibility for ordinary resources containing JPEG data with a `.png` extension through lossless renaming to `.jpg`; nine-patch resources and naming conflicts remain fail-closed

这是面向真实 APK 兼容性校准的 Alpha 预发布版本。请先在测试设备和非生产 APK 上验证加固、签名、安装与启动流程；暂不包含批量加固、生产级内存 DEX 或直接 AAB 加固。

This is an Alpha pre-release focused on real APK compatibility calibration. Validate protection, signing, installation, and startup on test devices and non-production APKs first. Batch protection, production in-memory DEX loading, and direct AAB protection are not included.
